name: qlrisk_price_interest_rate_floor
title: Price a InterestRateFloor
description:
Price one Interest Rate Floor - series of floorlets (qlrisk InterestRateFloor): NPV, pricing components and Greeks where the pricer gives them.
Inputs (* required): maturity* (tenor like 3Y or date), notional (amount; default 1000000), strike_pct* (percent, 3 = 3%), floating_index (see the schema's list; default SOFR), frequency (annual/semi-annual/quarterly/monthly/weekly/daily/at maturity; default quarterly), volatility_pct (percent, 3 = 3%), currency (see the schema's list; default USD). Rates are in percent, spreads in basis points, maturities a tenor (3Y, 18M, 6W, 10D) or a date YYYY-MM-DD. Optional `advanced`: trade_id, trade_date, effective_date, counterparty_id, day_count, position, market_data, reporting_currency, include_cash_flows; market data defaults to qlrisk's sample snapshot valued today.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "notional": 1000000, "strike_pct": 3} gives NPV 45,309.64 USD on the sample market valued 2026-10-09. For several trades at once use qlrisk_price_trades.
